provenance: synthetic teaching cases, not runtime observations

cases.task: Write the caller, namespace, API group, resource, name and verb for an owned hello Deployment read.
cases.expected: A six-field request includes apps/deployments, hello, get and the explicit leased namespace.

cases.task: Compare get hello with list deployments and create namespaces under the example Role.
cases.expected: Only get hello is granted by this Role; list and namespace creation are absent.

cases.task: Compare the ns-1 receipt with the ns-2 readback.
cases.expected: Refuse despite the matching namespace name and owner label.

cases.task: With an explicitly provisioned lease, record an own-namespace permitted action and a denied cluster/Secret action.
cases.expected: Actual allow/deny results are recorded separately from source policy; no credentials enter the worksheet.

cases.task: A RoleBinding in namespace lesson-a references the built-in ClusterRole view. Predict whether the bound identity can list Pods in lesson-a, list Pods in lesson-b and list Secrets in lesson-a.
cases.expected: Pods in lesson-a: allowed. Pods in lesson-b: denied, because a RoleBinding grants only inside its own namespace. Secrets in lesson-a: denied, because the default view role excludes Secrets.

cases.task: Describe why one narrow Role file cannot prove that no other privilege exists.
cases.expected: A written answer includes other RoleBindings/ClusterRoleBindings and actual effective authorization evidence.
